### Letting Go of the Need to Keep Up - Your Nightly Prayer - July 15th
Author: Shea Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/letting-go-of-the-need-to-keep-up.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 4:6
Points:
- Society constantly pressures people to chase upgrades and keep up with their peers.
- Endless striving and comparison unravel peace, joy, and family relationships.
- The illusion that the grass is greener leads into dangerous worldly entanglements.
- Finding true delight in God brings quiet contentment over ceaseless toil.

### Two Are Better Than One
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/two-are-better-than-one
Passage: Ecclesiastes 4:9-10
Points:
- Human beings were never designed to work, live, or face hardship in complete isolation.
- Walking alongside another person offers perspective, objectivity, and courage during threatening circumstances.
- Shared effort yields far better results than solitary labor.
- In moments of weakness and stumble, a trusted companion provides vital help instead of walking away.
